six novel grounded inductance simulators have been presented using the DCCII.
the proposed circuits are simple and compact, and can be easily implemented in the integrated form using standard CMOS technology.

the development of novel lossless grounded simulator circuit topologies using the DCCII.
the design and implementation of novel grounded inductance simulators using the DCCII.
the design of the grounded lossless inductance simulator, using the DCCII.

the proposed circuits can be considered as the best choice in the design of high-performance inductor simulator and filter circuits.
